We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON tree: root molecule, children reactions etc.

We need to select appropriate templates for each step: likely disconnection of amide (C=O-N) to carboxylic acid and aniline; disconnection of sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride and aniline; disconnection of alpha,beta-unsaturated amide side chain via Doebner modification: break C=C and carboxylate to aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually forward Doebner: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid. So retrosynthesis: break the C=C and carboxylate to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. In our target, we have /C=C/C(=O)N... So the unsaturated amide side chain: phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Actually structure: ...c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the unsaturated carboxamide attached to phenyl ring via double bond. So we can disconnect the double bond and carbonyl to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) and malonic acid derivative? Wait Doebner gives unsaturated carboxylic acid, not amide. But we could first get unsaturated acid then convert to amide later (step 1). So retrosynthesis steps: 1) amide formation (carboxylic acid + aniline). 2) Doebner modification to form unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid. 3) sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride + aniline.

Thus three steps: final target -> disconnect amide -> get unsaturated acid + aniline (c3ccccc3N). Then disconnect unsaturated acid via Doebner: get aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) + malonic acid. Then disconnect sulfonamide: get sulfonyl chloride (SO2Cl attached to phenyl) + aniline (the other phenyl with methyl). Actually sulfonamide is NS(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl ring (para-methyl phenyl). So we need sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the phenyl with methyl). Wait the sulfonamide is attached to the first phenyl (with methyl). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to that phenyl? Actually SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(... )cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the first phenyl (para-methyl). So disconnection: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the same phenyl? Actually the nitrogen is attached to the phenyl ring as substituent; after cleavage we get the aniline (the phenyl with methyl) as the amine? Wait the sulfonamide is R-N-SO2-Ar where R is the phenyl with methyl (the same as the sulfonyl? Actually the SMILES: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(... )cc2) cc1. So the nitrogen is attached to the first phenyl (with methyl) and also to the sulfonyl group which is attached to second phenyl (with unsaturated amide). So the sulfonamide is between the two aromatic rings: the nitrogen is bridging them via sulfonyl group. So disconnection of S-N yields sulfonyl chloride attached to second phenyl (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl chloride would be attached to the second phenyl (c2ccc...). The amine would be the first phenyl with methyl (p-toluidine). So step 3: sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) + p-toluidine.

Thus we need templates IDs. We don't know IDs; we can search template catalog by criteria. Let's search for amide formation template (carboxylic acid + amine). Use functional_groups_broken: "aliphatic carboxylic acid". functional_groups_formed: "C-N". Let's search.
